html:
G'oya

Balans bu shu paytgacha bajarilgan barcha amallarning yig'indisi, ya'ni o'sib boruvchi SUM. Uni har bir amaldan keyin hisoblaymiz, balans manfiy bo'lgan qatorlardan esa eng erta kunni olamiz.

Yechim

WITH b AS (
  SELECT account_id, day,
         SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY day, id) AS balance
  FROM transactions
)
SELECT account_id, MIN(day) AS first_negative_day
FROM b
WHERE balance < 0
GROUP BY account_id

Namunada 1-hisobda balans 500, 200, -200, 800 bo'lib boradi: birinchi minus 5-kuni. 2-hisob 0 gacha tushadi, lekin 0 minus emas. 3-hisob birinchi amaldayoq -50 ga tushadi.

Tuzoqlar

Faqat ORDER BY day yozish. Gap faqat kun ichidagi tartibda emas, freymda ham. Standart freym RANGE: bir kundagi amallar bir-biriga "teng" hisoblanadi va hammasi birdaniga qo'shiladi, har qatorda kun oxiridagi balans chiqadi. 5-kuni avval -200, keyin +300 bo'lsa, kun oxiri musbat va balans minusga tushgan lahza ko'rinmay qoladi:

Noto'g'riWITH b AS (
  SELECT account_id, day,
         SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY day) AS balance
  FROM transactions
)
SELECT account_id, MIN(day) AS first_negative_day
FROM b
WHERE balance < 0
GROUP BY account_id

id qo'shilgach, har bir qator alohida bo'ladi va balans amalma-amal hisoblanadi. Lekin yolg'iz ORDER BY id ham xato: shartda id kunlar tartibini bildirmasligi aytilgan.

Manfiy amal bo'lgan kun balans minusga tushgan kun emas. Namunada 1-hisobdan 3-kuni 300 chiqqan, lekin hisobda hali 200 qolgan.
